description: This is a PHP class source file for the 'Factory' class in the Opencart System Engine namespace. It defines the Factory class with its constructor and methods for creating controllers, models, and libraries, as well as its property for the registry.

classes.name: Opencart ody actory
classes.description: The Factory class responsible for creating controllers, models, and libraries within the Opencart system engine namespace.

methods.name: __construct
